item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Sleep. Your calendar already has the pieces: a relaxation session at 8:30 p.m. and bedtime at 10:15. Treat those as fixed, not suggestions. Evening screens and late planning pull you away from them, so protect that stretch. Your best sleep tonight depends on a steady wind-down, not willpower at midnight. Here's your action: start the relaxation session at 8:30 sharp, phone out of reach.
